title: Residents urged to keep pets out of Stoughton pond after dog’s death
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Stoughton officials warn residents to keep pets out of Ames Pond after a dog's death potentially linked to an algae bloom.
Algae blooms, which result from rapid cyanobacteria growth, can be harmful to humans and deadly to animals, officials explain.
Ames Pond is tested weekly for E. Coli, but recent tests have not shown concerning results, prompting further algae investigations.

title: Former NH state trooper decertified after misleading police about using GPS to track girlfriend
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: James Lamoureux, 43, a former NH state trooper, pleaded guilty to making false reports about using GPS to track his girlfriend.
Lamoureux placed GPS devices on his and his girlfriend's vehicles, then falsely claimed someone else was responsible.
He will resign from the force, lose his law enforcement certification, and be barred from future police employment.

title: Man polishing powder horn outside Lexington church prompts bizarre police response
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Lexington police responded to a gun report at Grace Chapel but found no public threat.
The man was polishing a historical powder horn, mistaken for a gun, while waiting for his wife.
Heavy police presence was due to programs inside, with parts of Worthen Road temporarily closed.

title: Longtime sports analyst Rob Parker not sold that Red Sox will make playoffs
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Rob Parker doubts the Boston Red Sox will maintain their winning pace and make the playoffs in 2026.
The Red Sox hold the second A.L. wild-card spot despite a recent loss to the Athletics, with a 64-52 record.
FanGraphs gives Boston a 96% chance of making the playoffs, with 83.4% odds for a wild-card spot.

title: Chad Tracy ‘hopeful’ Wilyer Abreu is back in Red Sox lineup Sunday
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Wilyer Abreu was scratched from the Red Sox lineup Saturday due to leg swelling from an injury in Friday's game.
Chad Tracy is hopeful Abreu will return for Sunday’s game, pending a morning assessment of his condition.
Abreu has hit 20 home runs and 62 RBIs this season, ranking second on the team in both categories.

title: Red Sox’ latest winning streak ends at 9 games after loss to Athletics
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Red Sox lose 7-3 to Athletics, ending a nine-game winning streak after out-hitting them 10-8.
Starting pitcher Jake Bennett allowed four earned runs over 5.1 innings, contributing to Boston's loss.
Boston remains second in the AL wild-card standings, 1.5 games behind the New York Yankees.

title: Here’s why Gillette Stadium is swapping out its turf surface again so soon after the World Cup
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Gillette Stadium will replace its turf surface due to an NFL procedural rule ahead of the Patriots' preseason game.
The current turf did not meet NFL lab testing due to opting out of the required 'E-layer' for ball bounce reasons.
A previously used 2025 turf version will be re-installed before the procedural testing can next occur in 2027.

title: 4 takeaways from the Revolution’s loss vs. Houston Dynamo
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: New England Revolution lost 2-0 to Houston Dynamo at Gillette Stadium, with goals from Guilherme and Agustin Resch.
Designated Player Jack Harrison debuted for New England in the second half but couldn't alter the team's offensive struggles.
Despite multiple attempts, New England's attack failed to bypass Houston's defense, resulting in a third consecutive identical lineup without success.

title: Here’s the latest injury updates on Roman Anthony, Adley Rutschman
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Roman Anthony has been ramping up his recovery with batting practice since a wrist injury in May.
Adley Rutschman rehabbed by catching for five innings for the Worcester Red Sox on Saturday.
The Red Sox acquired Rutschman before the deadline; he's closer to returning than Anthony.

title: New on Netflix and more: Top streaming picks for August 2026
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Clueless' (1995) featuring Alicia Silverstone streams on Netflix, YouTube, Peacock, Pluto TV, and Paramount+ in August.
New movies 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' and 'The Ballad of Wallis Island' join streaming platforms this month.
'Voicemails for Isabelle', starring Zoey Deutch and Nick Robinson, is available on Netflix as a rom-com recommendation.
